product_overview: TrustCart is a smart product comparison backend that helps shoppers compare product listings across major e-commerce marketplaces. It extracts product details from a supplied URL, discovers matching listings, and returns comparison data to support better buying decisions.
core_goals: Validate supported product URLs and identify the originating marketplace
Extract accurate product metadata and current selling prices from marketplace pages
Discover comparable listings across Amazon and Flipkart
Match equivalent products using normalized brand, model, name, and category data
Compare prices and return a stable API response for frontend consumers
Handle invalid inputs, extraction failures, and marketplace blocking with meaningful errors

features.name: Product comparison API
features.description: Accept a product URL, analyze the source listing, find comparable marketplace listings, and return comparison data including prices, trust signals, and recommendations.
user_flows: POST /api/products/compare with a valid Amazon or Flipkart product URL -> Receive 200 with comparison result containing extracted product details and matched marketplace listings -> Display comparison data to the user

POST /api/products/compare with a valid product URL that has no comparable matches -> Receive 200 with a comparison response indicating limited or no matches found -> Display an informative no-comparison result
POST /api/products/compare with a malformed or unsupported URL -> Receive 400 validation error -> Display a meaningful error message explaining the URL could not be processed

features.name: Product analysis API
features.description: Fetch and analyze a single marketplace product page to extract product name, brand, model, price, category, source, and URL.
user_flows: POST /api/products/analyze with a valid marketplace product URL -> Receive 200 with ProductAnalysis data including extracted metadata and current price -> Use the analysis output for downstream comparison
POST /api/products/analyze with a URL from an unsupported website or an invalid format -> Receive 400 validation error -> Return an error message indicating the URL is unsupported or malformed

features.name: Marketplace search and discovery
features.description: Search supported marketplaces for candidate products by keyword and return candidate listings for matching and comparison.
user_flows: GET /api/products/discover?keyword=wireless+headphones -> Receive 200 with a list of candidate Amazon and Flipkart products -> Use candidates for product matching and price comparison

GET /api/products/discover with an empty or missing keyword, or a keyword that triggers a request/fetch failure -> Receive an error response indicating invalid input or discovery failure -> Show a meaningful discovery error to the user
